contrast_not_archived.citation: M. Zabransky and V. Ruzicka Jr., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 23(1), 55-61 (1994)
contrast_not_archived.rights: Copyright 1994 by the U.S. Secretary of Commerce, assigned to the American Institute of Physics and the American Chemical Society. Not redistributed; only the few values below are quoted for contrast.

review.method: Manual transcription; every cited page, equation and table row inspected on rendered page images. The ThermoML file is read by the auditor, not transcribed.

required_property.use: sensible enthalpy of the liquid between the reference and its boiling point at the reference pressure

relation.form: Cp(T,P0) = Csat(T) + T*(dV/dT)_p*(dPsat/dT) - T*integral from Psat to P0 of (d2V/dT2)_p dP
relation.first_term_sources: Osborne and Ginnings 1947 printed p.471 (PDF p.19); Zabransky and Ruzicka 1994 eq.(9) printed p.60
relation.second_term_basis: Maxwell relation (dCp/dP)_T = -T*(d2V/dT2)_p; named as needed by Osborne and Ginnings p.471
needs: saturation pressure and its temperature derivative

liquid_rows_below_290.locator: calorimetry printed p.149, PDF p.11, Table 5, at saturation pressures

volumetric.temperature_scale: ITS-90 assumed for a 2008 measurement; the article was not inspected

contrast_jpcrd_1994.table_4_locator: printed p.60, PDF p.6: reference Csat and Cp on ITS-90
contrast_jpcrd_1994.table_2_locator: printed p.58, PDF p.4: NBS and Bureau of Mines columns and deviation d at the same numerical temperature
contrast_jpcrd_1994.table_2_unit: K(ITS-90),J/(mol*K) NBS,percent d NBS,J/(mol*K) Bureau of Mines
contrast_jpcrd_1994.cp_definition: isobaric at the saturation pressure, eq.(9); volume derivative taken along saturation
contrast_jpcrd_1994.conversion_statement: exact conversion needs raw heat, initial and final temperatures; applying the correction formula to smoothed values is not exact (printed pp.56-57)
contrast_jpcrd_1994.above_360_k: only temperatures were converted (Table 2 footnote d)

bureau_of_mines_liquid_calorimetry.locator: printed p.59, PDF p.5, quoting McCullough and Messerly, U.S. Bur. Mines Bull. 596 (1961)
bureau_of_mines_liquid_calorimetry.applies_to: liquid calorimetry of 1947-1954, not the 1947 vapour-flow calorimetry

contrast_bulletin_666.locator: D. W. Scott, U.S. Bureau of Mines Bulletin 666 (1974), Table 14, printed p.17, PDF p.23
contrast_bulletin_666.independence: the correlation uses the extant vapour heat capacity data, so it is not independent of the cited calorimetry above 357 K

gas_original_calorimetry.citation: G. Waddington, S. S. Todd and H. M. Huffman, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 69, 22 (1947)
gas_original_calorimetry.reason: publisher copy not open; not found on the NIST or OSTI servers

negative_searches: NBS Circular 461 (1947): densities at 20 and 25 degC only, no density-temperature table for n-heptane
Smith, Beattie and Kay, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 59, 1587 (1937): publisher copy not open, not obtained
No primary measurement of isobaric Cp of the liquid at 100 kPa over 280-371 K was found; the calorimetric standard is Csat by construction
